name: xweather
description: Xweather Weather API, Raster Maps, MapsGL, and Webhooks — build and run Weather API request URLs, generate static map images and tile URLs, work with the MapsGL JavaScript and Apple-platform SDKs, and set up push data delivery.

interface.longDescription: Reusable Xweather skills for building Weather API requests, Raster Maps imagery and tiles, MapsGL integrations for the web and for Apple platforms, and webhook receivers.
defaultPrompt: Build an Xweather Weather API request and report its access cost.
Add an Xweather map to my web or SwiftUI application.
Help me design a secure Xweather webhook receiver.
